identifiers.note: This is the repo's EXISTING, real UUIDv8 deterministic-derivation mechanism. It is the correct tool for DERIVED identities (e.g. a repository coordinate signature, or a binding-evidence key) once a canonical namespace/name is independently proven -- exactly the caveat the design gate names. It must NOT be used to derive stableFileId from path or content, because RFC 9562 UUIDv8/v5-style determinism from a mutable attribute (path) fails rename semantics by definition (same function, same input, must give the same output -- but a renamed file needs the SAME stableFileId under a DIFFERENT path, which a deterministic-from-path function cannot express).
